traceAs.run/lock.cjs: the lock primitive, inside its caller's step: publish counts the waits (n.waits); kit has no step of its own
traceAs.run/traced.cjs: the writer of every step's record; a record of itself would be one per record
traceAs.run/child.cjs: the starter of a background child, inside its caller's step: the caller's records say what it did
traceAs.run/person.cjs: the answer to who acts, told to the composition root with every answer: the cli writes its row (step actor) in one format
traceAs.run/store.cjs: the seal's answer, inside the step of the gate that asks: that gate writes the coded row (STORE_SEALED)
